entities.name: GlmU-like bifunctional enzyme
observations: 497-aa query has strongest reviewed Swiss-Prot matches to bacterial GlmU, at 53.9–56.0% identity and about 94–95% query coverage (query_protein result).

Homology-based function is bifunctional UDP-GlcNAc synthesis: N-terminal uridyltransferase and C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate acetyltransferase; specific query activity is inferred, not experimentally established.
Sequence analysis estimates molecular mass 51.7 kDa and pI 4.93; predicted Pfam hits include NTP-transferase/pyrophosphorylase-region families and a C-terminal Hexapep hit.
